## File: facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/mms/lid/infer.py

Prompts

```
['run language identification inference on audio files using a fairseq model and manifest', 'run subset_manifest to filter an inference manifest based on verification pairs', 'run wrap_target_dataset to add language labels from a .lang file to an audio dataset', 'run resample_sample to create multiple random crops of audio samples for inference', 'run dict_to_nparr to convert a fairseq dictionary symbols list into numpy arrays']
```

